subject: Gen6-compatible Lane F claim: causal debugging data gaps
body: STARTING_MAIN_SHA=699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2. LANE=F virtual-hinge telemetry/debugging, narrowed to the newest Primary Gen6 hotfix/debug-data-gap directive. SUBPROBLEM=define and source-validate one causal timeline that separates physical wake, logical inner availability, useful/interactive presentation, coarse public 90-degree samples vs trusted angle authority, post-terminal NATIVE_COVER mutations, and requested-vs-actual 120Hz cadence/lease lifecycle. CURRENT_TOUCHPOINTS=hinge authority, opening wake/presentation, route/mirror/power terminal fencing, refresh-rate telemetry. ACTIVE_OVERLAP=prior Lane D 120Hz and Gen5 geometry work; this session will not duplicate their platform/geometry analysis. INDEPENDENT_BOUNDARY=instrumentation schema, exact source insertion points, invariants, replay/diagnostic completeness, and targeted tests only. CHEAPEST_DECISIVE_FIRST_ACTION=map current-main call sites and existing diagnostics, then identify missing facts required to explain the known field failures without inference. EXPECTED_ARTIFACT=implementation-grade data-gap matrix + event schema + source touchpoints + focused test plan. Production writes prohibited.
